label: Shielded — banked around the inner shrine
location: The Ashen Shrine, the inner shrine
injuries: Burning low: strength spent on walls that was meant for hearths

recentEvents.value: The hearth-keepers are evacuating down the warm-galleries; wisps that should be carrying supper-heat are fencing the intruder instead.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Every beam laid as a wall is a home going cold somewhere in the hearth-cities.

temporaryObjective.value: Hold the inner shrine until the last hearth-keeper is down the gallery.
